title: 3D Elevation Program — Virtual USA in 3D
summary: USGS Fact Sheet 2016–3022. How airborne lidar fires hundreds of thousands of laser pulses a second, bounces them off trees, buildings and the ground beneath the trees, and turns the echoes into a 3D map of the country.

title: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program (Fact Sheet 017-03)
summary: USGS Fact Sheet 017-03. Includes how lidar, used in heavily forested regions like the Pacific Northwest, revealed previously unknown faults in the Seattle and Puget Sound area — such as the Toe Jam Hill fault, marked by a conspicuous east–west topographic trend.
